facebook.notConnectedDesc: Configure your Zernio credentials below to connect your Facebook Page.
facebook.apiCredentialsDesc: Enter the credentials from your Zernio dashboard.
facebook.zernioAccountIdHint: Find this at zernio.com/dashboard/connections, under your connected Facebook Page.
facebook.tokenHidden: Key is hidden for security. Re-enter it to update configuration.
facebook.webhookDesc: In your Zernio dashboard, go to Webhooks → Add Webhook, paste this URL, and select the message.received event.
facebook.webhookSecretGenerated: Copy this now — it won't be shown again. Paste it into the Secret field when creating the webhook in Zernio.
facebook.webhookSecretAlreadySet: A webhook secret was already generated for this connection. If you lost it, reset the configuration to generate a new one.
facebook.setupInstructionsDesc: Follow these steps to connect your Facebook Page.
facebook.step1_2: Connect your Facebook Page (no Meta Business Verification needed)
facebook.step2_1: Create an API Key at zernio.com/dashboard/api-keys
facebook.step2_2: Copy the connected Page's Account ID from Connections
facebook.step3_1: Paste the Webhook Callback URL from above
facebook.step3_2: Paste the Webhook Secret shown after saving

googleCalendar.title: Google Calendar
googleCalendar.description: Connect your Google Calendar so the AI assistant can check your real availability and schedule appointments — the customer gets Google's own invite email automatically.
googleCalendar.disconnectConfirm: This disconnects Google Calendar from Chat Sandía — the AI won't be able to check availability or schedule appointments until you reconnect. Continue?
googleCalendar.aboutBody: Chat Sandía only requests permission to check free/busy times and create events — never to read the details of your other events.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: How you show up across the app. Your avatar and name appear in the header, sidebar, and anywhere your teammates see you.
profile.photoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP, or GIF. Up to 2 MB.
profile.emailChangeHint: Check the inbox for <bold>{oldEmail}</bold> and <bold>{newEmail}</bold> — both need to confirm before the change takes effect.
profile.unsupportedImageDesc: Use PNG, JPG, WebP, or GIF.
profile.profileSavedEmailCheck: Profile saved — check your email to confirm the address change
profile.passwordDesc: Use at least {min} characters. You will stay signed in on this device after changing it.
profile.cannotChangeNoEmail: Cannot change password without a current email
profile.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters
profile.passwordMismatch: New password and confirmation do not match
profile.sessionsDesc: Sign out of every device where you're logged in — including this one. Useful if you lost a laptop or shared your password.
profile.signOutConfirmDesc: Every device logged into this account will be signed out and will need to log in again. You will be redirected to the login page.

appearance.fontSizeHint: Enlarges everything in the app. Saved to this device.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Set the mode and accent colour used across the app. Saved to this device — try it, it changes live.

security.title: Login & security
security.description: Change your password and sign out of your devices. These keep your account safe.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys authenticate the public REST API (<apiCode>/api/v1</apiCode>) so you can build your own automations. Send them as <headerCode>Authorization: Bearer <key></headerCode>.
apiKeys.createOneHint: Click <bold>New API key</bold> to create one.
apiKeys.askAdminHint: Ask an admin to create one.
apiKeys.scopesHint: A key with no scopes can still call GET /api/v1/me to verify it works.
apiKeys.copyDesc: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it somewhere safe — if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
apiKeys.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
apiKeys.newKeyDesc: Name it after the integration that will use it, and grant only the scopes it needs.

webhooksTab.title: Webhooks
webhooksTab.description: Get notified in real time when something happens — new leads, closed deals, closed conversations, and more. Point an n8n workflow (or any HTTPS endpoint) at a webhook and verify the signature to receive them securely.
webhooksTab.askAdminHint: Ask an admin to create one.
webhooksTab.copyDesc: This is the only time the full secret is shown. Store it somewhere safe — you'll need it to verify the X-Wacrm-Signature header on every delivery.
webhooksTab.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
webhooksTab.newWebhookDesc: Choose which events to send and where — an n8n Webhook trigger node works well as the destination.

deals.title: Deals & currency
deals.description: The currency used for new deals and for pipeline and dashboard totals.
deals.companyNameDesc: Shown across the dashboard and in messages sent on this account's behalf.
deals.companyNameSaveFailed: Failed to save the company name
deals.defaultCurrencyDesc: New deals default to this currency, and pipeline and dashboard totals are shown in it. Existing deals keep the currency they were saved with.
deals.adminOnlyHint: Only account admins can change the default currency.
deals.timezoneDesc: The AI assistant uses this to know today's real date and time when scheduling appointments — without it, "now" defaults to UTC, which can be a day off from your local time.

aiConfig.title: Agent setup
aiConfig.description: Bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic key. Chat Sandía calls the provider directly with your key — no per-seat AI fees, and your data stays yours. This powers AI-drafted replies in the inbox, the auto-reply bot, and the Playground.
aiConfig.adminOnlyConfig: Only admins and owners can change the AI configuration.
aiConfig.encryptionNotice: Your key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again after saving.
aiConfig.embeddingsHint: An OpenAI key used only to embed your knowledge base (text-embedding-3-small){sameKeyText}. Leave blank to use keyword search instead. Clear it to turn semantic search off.
aiConfig.sameKeyText: — can be the same key as above
aiConfig.behaviourDesc: Tell the assistant about your business — products, tone, what it may and may not promise. This context feeds both drafts and auto-replies.
aiConfig.promptPlaceholder: e.g. We are Acme, a coffee-equipment store. Be warm and concise. Never quote prices or delivery dates — hand off to a human for those.
aiConfig.enableAssistantDesc: Master switch. Turns on the “Draft with AI” button in the inbox.
aiConfig.autoReplyDesc: The bot answers new inbound messages automatically (only when no flow handles them and no agent is assigned). Hands off to a human when it can’t help.
aiConfig.autoScheduleAppointmentsDesc: When a customer clearly wants to book a time, the bot creates the real Google Calendar event itself — no confirmation step — using only slots your calendar actually shows as free, and only with an email it already knows or the customer wrote in the chat. Guide it with rules in “Business context & instructions” below. Requires Google Calendar connected in Settings → Google Calendar; otherwise this has no effect.
aiConfig.askCustomerTaxInfo: Ask for tax ID and email on quotes
aiConfig.askCustomerTaxInfoDesc: Off by default — the bot only asks for a delivery address before building a quote from chat. Turn this on only if your business needs the customer's tax ID (NIT) and email for invoicing. Doesn't affect the manual quote builder, where both fields are always optional.
aiConfig.maxAutoRepliesDesc: After this many bot replies in one thread, the bot goes quiet.
aiConfig.handoffToDesc: When the bot can’t help — or hits the reply cap — it pauses and routes the chat here, with a short note on what happened.
aiConfig.handoffQueue: Unassigned queue (any agent can pick it up)
aiConfig.unclaimedTimeoutDesc: If an open conversation sits this long with no agent assigned, it's automatically assigned to an available (online) advisor.
aiConfig.followupsDesc: When a customer goes quiet mid-chat without booking a demo, send one or more nudges after a delay you set. Runs on a schedule — independent of the auto-reply bot — only while the chat is still open, unassigned, and hasn't been handed to a human.
aiConfig.followupsEnableDesc: Turn the whole sequence on or off. WhatsApp conversations only.
aiConfig.followupsBusinessHoursDesc: Restrict nudges to your account's local hours (start–end, 24h). Set them equal for no restriction.
aiConfig.followupsStepsHint: Sent in order. Each delay counts from the previous message (the customer's last reply, then the previous nudge). Up to {max} steps.
aiConfig.followupsNoSteps: No steps yet — add one below.
aiConfig.followupsTextPlaceholder: e.g. Hi {{nombre}}, just checking in on our chat — happy to answer any questions.
aiConfig.followupsTextHint: Use {{nombre}} for the contact's name. Written messages only deliver within 24h of the customer's last message — past that, use a template.
aiConfig.followupsTemplateHint: Only APPROVED templates are listed. A template is the only thing WhatsApp delivers more than 24h after the customer's last message.
aiConfig.followupsTemplateHasVars: This template expects variables. The follow-up sends it without filling them in, so WhatsApp may reject it — pick a template with no variables.
aiConfig.followupsNoTemplates: No approved WhatsApp templates yet — create one in Settings → Templates to use this option.
aiConfig.followupsIncomplete: Finish every follow-up step (message text or a template) before saving.

aiKnowledge.title: Knowledge base
aiKnowledge.description: Add FAQs, policies, or product details. The assistant retrieves the relevant pieces when drafting and auto-replying, so it can answer instead of handing off.{searchType}
aiKnowledge.semanticSearchOn: Semantic search is on (embeddings key set).
aiKnowledge.keywordSearchOn: Using keyword search — add an embeddings key above for semantic search.
aiKnowledge.editDocContentPlaceholder: Paste the FAQ answer, policy text, or product details…
aiKnowledge.reindexTooltip: Re-embed all documents (e.g. after adding an embeddings key)

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.notConnectedBody: Connect a Google Calendar to see your upcoming appointments here.
Calendar.reconnectBody: The Google Calendar connection expired. Reconnect it to keep seeing your appointments.
Calendar.errorGeneric: Could not load the calendar. Try again.
Calendar.agendaEmpty: No upcoming events in this period.
